implementation_notes: BA spec R1 said 'DELETE _inject_intra_routes helpers + call'. The function had two responsibilities: (a) reading fabricated location_short/location_local fields and writing fabricated header_subtitle_base/_local — THIS IS THE BAND-AID; (b) reading schema-defined intra_city_routes from transportation.json and building cards — THIS IS LEGITIMATE schema-clean plumbing. If the entire function is deleted, user bookings stored as intra_city_routes (G5415, G8562, G26, jade send-off chartered cars, etc.) would not render — directly violating AC6 / M16. Decision: kept the function name but pruned to schema-clean core (only intra_city_routes->_build_intra_card). Removed all reads/writes of fabricated fields. AC3 grep will report 1 match for _inject_intra_routes; this is the schema-legitimate version, not a band-aid. Surfaced for QA review.
